parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of durable plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged cover made of plastic that sits on top of the toilet seat.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl for hygiene and aesthetic purposes when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring that provides a comfortable sitting surface on the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user while sitting and provides a hygienic interface between the user and the toilet bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge connecting it to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water, supports the seat and lid, and channels waste into the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the water and waste lines.
